ayahs.textIndopak: يَسْـٔ͏َلُكَ النَّاسُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِؕ قُلْ اِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَا يُدْرِيْكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُوْنُ قَرِيْبًا
ayahs.translation: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allāh. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."
ayahs.transliteration: Yas'alukan-naasu 'anis-saa'ati qul innamaa 'ilmuhaa 'indallaahi wamaa yudreeka la'allas-saa'ata takoonu qareebaa
ayahs.translationClear: The people ask you about the Hour. Say, “The knowledge thereof rests with Allah. But what do you know? Perhaps the Hour is near.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَعَنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيْرًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.
ayahs.transliteration: Innallaaha la'anal-kaafireena wa'a'adda lahum sa'eeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Allah has cursed the disbelievers, and has prepared for them a Blaze.

ayahs.textUthmani: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا‌ۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا͏ٓ اَبَدًاۚ لَا يَجِدُوْنَ وَلِيًّا وَّلَا نَصِيْرًا ۚ
ayahs.translation: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.
ayahs.transliteration: Khaalideena feehaa abadal laa yajidoona waliyyan walaa naseeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Dwelling therein forever, not finding a protector or a savior.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَـٰلَيْتَنَآ أَطَعْنَا ٱللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَا۠
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَـٰلَيْتَنَآ أَطَعْنَا ٱللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَا۠ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوْهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ يَقُوْلُوْنَ يٰلَيْتَنَا͏ٓ اَطَعْنَا اللّٰهَ وَاَطَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَا
ayahs.translation: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allāh and obeyed the Messenger."
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fin-naari yaqooloona yaalaytanaa ata'nallaaha wa'ata'nar-rasool
ayahs.translationClear: The Day when their faces are flipped into the Fire, they will say, “If only we had obeyed Allah and obeyed the Messenger.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّآ أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا ٱلسَّبِيلَا۠
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّآ أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا ٱلسَّبِيلَا۠ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اِنَّا͏ٓ اَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَا࢜ءَنَا فَاَضَلُّوْنَا السَّبِيْلَا
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries,[1213] and they led us astray from the [right] way.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo rabbanaa innaa ata'naa saadatanaa wakubaraa'anaa fa'adalloonas-sabeel

footnotes.1213: Also interpreted to mean "our noble ones and our elders [i.e., distinguished scholars]."

ayahs.translationClear: And they will say, “Lord, we have obeyed our superiors and our dignitaries, but they led us away from the way.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اٰتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbanaa aatihim di'fayni minal-'adhaabi wal-'anhum la'nan kabeeraa
ayahs.translationClear: Lord, give them double the punishment, and curse them with a great curse.”

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا۟ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا۟ ۚ وَكَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَجِيهًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا۟ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا۟‌ۚ وَكَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَجِيهًا ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُوْنُوْا كَالَّذِيْنَ اٰذَوْا مُوْسٰي فَبَرَّاَهُ اللّٰهُ مِمَّا قَالُوْاؕ وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَجِيْهًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allāh cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allāh, was distinguished.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa'ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takoonoo kal-ladheena aadhaw moosaa fabarra'ahullaahu mimmaa qaaloo wakaana 'indallaahi wajeehaa
ayahs.translationClear: O you who believe! Do not be like those who abused Moses; but Allah cleared him of what they said. He was distinguished with Allah.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَقُوْلُوْا قَوْلًا سَدِيْدًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa'ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha waqooloo qawlan sadeedaa
ayahs.translationClear: O you who believe! Be conscious of Allah, and speak in a straightforward manner.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ‌ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: يُّصْلِحْ لَكُمْ اَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوْبَكُمْؕ وَمَنْ يُّطِعِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا
ayahs.translation: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: Yuslih lakum a'maalakum wayaghfir lakum dhunoobakum waman yuti'illaaha warasoolahoo faqad faaza fawzan 'azeemaa
ayahs.translationClear: He will rectify your conduct for you, and will forgive you your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has won a great victory.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا ٱلْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا ٱلْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْاَمَانَةَ عَلَي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَاَبَيْنَ اَنْ يَّحْمِلْنَهَا وَاَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْاِنْسَانُؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ ظَلُوْمًا جَهُوْلًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We offered the Trust[1214] to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.[1215]
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa 'aradnal-amaanata 'alas-samaawaati wal-ardi wal-jibaali fa'abayna an yahmilnahaa wa'ashfaqna minhaa wahamalahal-insaanu innahoo kaana zalooman jahoolaa

footnotes.1214: The acceptance of obligations and obedience to Allāh.
footnotes.1215: Coveting its reward while forgetting the penalty for failure to keep his commitment.

ayahs.translationClear: We offered the Trust to the heavens, and the earth, and the mountains; but they refused to bear it, and were apprehensive of it; but the human being accepted it. He was unfair and ignorant.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۢا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ‌ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًۢا ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لِّيُعَذِّبَ اللّٰهُ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ وَالْمُنٰفِقٰتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِيْنَ وَالْمُشْرِكٰتِ وَيَتُوْبَ اللّٰهُ عَلَي الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنٰتِؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: [It[1216] was] so that Allāh may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allāh may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyu'adhdhiballaahul-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-mushrikeena wal-mushrikaati wayatooballaahu 'alal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa

footnotes.1216: The reason for which mankind was permitted to carry the Trust.

ayahs.translationClear: Allah will punish the hypocrites, men and women, and the idolaters, men and women. And Allah will redeem the believers, men and women. Allah is Ever-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
